hook_text: No chiefs, no kings, no rich and poor. How did it work?
clip_script: A camp fire near the Kgalagadi, under the Milky Way. A San storyteller shares the old ways. San bands were small groups of families. When hunters brought meat home, everyone got a share, so no one went hungry. There were no chiefs: decisions were made by talking. Boasting was teased away. And at night, women clapped and sang while healers danced into a trance. The eland was the most special animal of all.
visual_style: Whiteboard fire circle under a starry sky, with meat portions passing hand to hand and dancers moving around the fire.
mood: Warm and peaceful, like a story told under the stars.
pacing: Slow and gentle, one idea at a time, ending with the dance.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and think about one way sharing makes your own class fairer.
